description: This Java class `ImmutableEntityIdWithResourceType` implements the `EntityIdWithResourceType` interface. It encapsulates an entity ID along with a resource type string and optional cache lookup context, providing methods for creation, deserialization from string, and standard object methods like equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: ImmutableEntityIdWithResourceType
classes.description: Immutable final class implementing `EntityIdWithResourceType`. It provides static factory methods for creation, deserialization, and ensures resource type consistency. It also overrides `equals`, `hashCode`, and `toString` for object comparison and easy string representation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an `EntityIdWithResourceType` from a resource type string and an EntityId.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Overloaded static factory method that includes a cache lookup context.

methods.name: readFrom
methods.description: Static method to deserialize an `EntityIdWithResourceType` from its string representation.

methods.name: getCacheLookupContext
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the cache lookup context if present.
